name: stage_1_learn_to_stand
description: Permissive standing reward — wobble is fine.  Trapezoid cap at 0.085 m, over-height penalty active so the body learns a clean upright pose.  No walking reward yet.  Auto-advance after 60 s of contiguous standing (3600 ticks @ 60 Hz).  Threshold lowered from the original 7200 (2 min) after the n=10 × 1-hour observational run showed zero seeds achieving 2-min contiguous standing — fall rate of 8-46 events/hr (mean inter-fall window 1.3-7.5 min) means 2-min stretches are statistically improbable in 1 hour.  60 s matches the OLD stand_wobbly threshold that successfully advanced in the user's 1h47m UI run.  Earlier intent was 'less crystallization time before walking transition' — 60 s preserves that intent at a feasible bar.

name: stage_2_learn_to_walk
description: Reward speed magnitude in ANY horizontal direction (walk_reward_mode=total_speed); no directional bias, body is 4-symmetric and has no front.  Velocity cap raised to 1.0 m/s so faster gaits earn measurably more reward.  Over-height penalty DISABLED (height_penalty_gain=0) so the body can lift, extend legs, push off — height stops mattering as long as the chassis doesn't hit the floor (FAIL_HEIGHT=0.025 m still triggers a fall).  PR pulse fires whenever current speed exceeds best-ever, on top of the continuous speed reward — refresh signal on each new personal record.  Auto-advance once body has held ≥0.5 m/s for at least 1 second contiguously (best_sustained_speed_ticks ≥ 60).

name: stage_3_walk_over_there
description: Terminal stage.  PLACEHOLDER — currently inherits stage 2's reward shape (total-speed + PR bonus).  Future work: random-quadrant target (spawn a coloured marker in one of the four corners, reward proportional to dist-reduction toward it, respawn marker on body contact).  Until built, this stage just keeps the body in the same total-speed regime it just learned — no direction bias, no calcification pressure.
